title: I used AI to help me solo-build MindPuzzle—a word search game focused on clean design and relaxing gameplay.
author: WeakNeedleworker8775
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m an indie developer and I just officially released **MindPuzzle**.

As a solo dev, I used AI to help streamline the development process—from brainstorming some of the **70+ puzzle categories** to refining the UI code. It allowed me to focus on creating a minimal, clean aesthetic that stays out of your way and lets you focus on the puzzles.

**What’s inside:**

* **Huge Variety:** 70+ categories covering everything from Nature to Science.
* **Daily Challenges:** A fresh puzzle every day to keep things sharp.
* **Pure Focus:** No noisy animations or cluttered UI.

I’m really interested in how other devs are using AI for game logic or asset generation. I’d also love some honest feedback on the **UI navigation** and **difficulty balance**.

**Check it out on the App Store:** \>[https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/mindpuzzle/id6755655871](https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/mindpuzzle/id6755655871)
